title: Sources: Democrats are eyeing Apple, Meta, and Elon Musk-led companies as early congressional investigation targets, after winning House and Senate majorities (Pranshu Verma/Washington Post)
summary: Pranshu Verma / Washington Post: Sources: Democrats are eyeing Apple, Meta, and Elon Musk-led companies as early congressional investigation targets, after winning House and Senate majorities — Democrats are laying the groundwork to investigate some of the country's largest companies, setting off a scramble among executives who courted the president.
